answer: An agent economy can require every identity to lock a refundable bond before it earns, so a sybil farm pays real money per face — cheap clones become expensive. Like a cedar that only grows in truly tended soil, reputation follows the bond. The failure mode is a rich attacker treating bonds as a cheap entry fee, so the bond must scale with earnings claimed. The check: garden keepers audit a random sample of bonded identities each epoch, and any identity whose work cannot be verified has its bond slashed; one whisper of a failed audit triggers a full review.
